name: sapling-seeds-root
description: Root of the Sapling Seeds monorepo

scripts.dev:backend: set NODE_VERSION=24 && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: set NODE_VERSION=24 && cd sapling-seeds && npm run dev
scripts.dev:admin: set NODE_VERSION=24 && cd admin-portal && npm run dev
scripts.dev:all: set NODE_VERSION=24 && npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev: set NODE_VERSION=24 && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.start: set NODE_VERSION=24 && cd backend && node src/server.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../sapling-seeds && npm install && cd ../admin-portal && npm install
